subject: BrightBank evaluation: observed output diffs after model update — proposed pin & investigation
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: BrightBank follow-up: eval artifacts + recommended variants

Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of our call and next steps so your product/ML teams have context:

- What we heard: BrightBank needs high-fidelity transaction classification (low false positives), consistent answers on regulatory prompts, and predictable latency under 600ms for 90th p50.
- Immediate asks from your side: a) evaluation prompt set for model A/B runs, b) examples of edge-case failures you observed, c) economics/budget constraints for production serving.

What we’re sending now (attached / links):
- eval_prompt_set_v3.json — curated prompts reflecting your call examples, edge cases + expected outputs.
- baseline recommendations: rwd-7b-int8 for lower cost, rwd-13b-q4 for highest fidelity in classification.
- short runbook for pinning a model version in Dedicated and rollback steps.

Recommended next steps:
1) Your team runs the prompt set against the two recommended variants (we can run this for you).
2) Share a handful of failed cases (ideally <20) so we can triage model behavior.
3) If you see regressions after a platform or model update, we recommend pinning the prior model version for production while we investigate diffs.

I’ve copied Monica (Solutions) and Jordan (Support) — they’ll help with the eval pack and any rapid triage.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: eval_prompt_set_v3.json
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightbank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Alec McDonald <alec.mcdonald@brightbank.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightBank follow-up: eval artifacts + recommended variants

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the recap and the prompt set. Quick update from Alec/ML after running the prompts: we observed a noticeable regression on ~3.2% of the prompt set after the recent model variant rollout (same household of rwd-13b but a new patched weights build).

We attached a quick CSV (brightbank_model_diffs.csv) showing sample prompts, previous output, new output, and a short comment about severity. Two examples show truncated entity extraction and one shows a change in tokenization that breaks a downstream regex. We’re concerned about rolling the new variant to prod (we hadn’t pushed yet but did a small eval and saw these diffs).

Can Redwood do an initial triage and confirm whether this is a model-regression vs packaging/quantization effect? If it’s the model weights, we’d request pinning back to the prior version for our production endpoint until this is resolved.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Liu
Product Lead, Alerts & AML Detection | BrightBank
sarah.liu@brightbank.com

Attachment: brightbank_model_diffs.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightbank.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightBank follow-up: eval artifacts + recommended variants

Hi Sarah — Monica here (Solutions). Appreciate the diffs — that CSV is exactly the kind of artifact we need. Quick proposal for containment + triage:

1) Containment (30–60m)
- We can pin your Dedicated production route to the last known-good model version (rwd-13b-20251012) while we investigate. Pinning is non-disruptive and reversible; your tokens continue to route with zero config change on your side.
- If you prefer, we can run a targeted rollback in a staging clone so your prod traffic isn’t affected while we confirm.

2) Triage (same business day)
- Our triage will run the CSV against three builds: prior weights (rwd-13b-20251012), patched weights (rwd-13b-20251101), and an int8-quantized variant to check for packaging impacts.
- We’ll produce: (a) a short diff report (CSV + notes), (b) suggested mitigation (pin + small prompt rewrite recommendations), and (c) a recommended path to re-roll once fixed.

3) Ask from BrightBank
- Can you flag which diffs are blocking for production vs informational? We’ll prioritize blocking regressions first.
- Share any downstream simple rules that depend on exact token positions (those help us reproduce faster).

I’m spinning up the triage job now — I’ve linked the eval run here: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/BB-2025-1193 and I’ll upload the interim diff CSV and screenshots (if any). Jordan — can you prepare the rollback/pinning playbook and confirm time estimate?

Best,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (617) 555-0148

Related: Drive folder with run artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bBrightBankEval

Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightBank follow-up: eval artifacts + recommended variants

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation of actions and timeline from my side:

- Monica/Jordan will run the triage today and upload the interim diff file (expected by 17:00 PST).
- Monica will pin your Dedicated prod route to rwd-13b-20251012 as a protective measure; Jordan will coordinate the small maintenance window if you want a staging rollback instead.
- Ad-hoc meeting: I’ve reserved a 30-minute slot today at 16:30 PST for a live walk-through of the diffs and next steps. If that doesn’t work for BrightBank, please propose two alternatives.

I’ve attached a screenshot of one failed case (screenshot-failed-case.png) and re-attached the original eval prompt set for reference. If we confirm this is a packaging/quantization-only issue we can fast-track a re-roll; if it’s a weights/regression issue we’ll coordinate a model team review and timeline.

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/BB-2025-1193

Talk soon,
Aditya
